sanskrit_verse: bahavo jñātayo yatra sakulyā bāndhavās tathā / yas tv āsannataras teṣāṃ so 'napatyadhanaṃ haret // BrhS_1,26.138
transliteration: bahavo jñātayo yatra sakulyā bāndhavās tathā / yas tv āsannataras teṣāṃ so 'napatyadhanaṃ haret
sph_interpretive_translation: Where many relatives, kinsmen, and family members exist, the one most proximate in relational capacity shall assume stewardship of the property of the childless deceased.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from relational proximity and recognized capacity to act
Causation is determined by natural relational continuity
Capacity-based responsibility flows from existential closeness, not formal appointment
Restoration logic prioritizes continuity of dharma-vyavahara (right conduct in transaction)
Consciousness alignment occurs through spontaneous dharmic duty assumption
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person dies without progeny AND has multiple living relatives AND one relative is identified as relationally proximate THEN that relative MUST assume custodianship of the estate UNTIL dharma-adhikari declares otherwise
RELATIONAL_PROXIMITY(x, y) = TRUE IF x demonstrates sustained dharmic engagement with y’s life-process
ESTATE_CUSTODY_TRANSFER(target_relative) = VALID IF no higher-dharma claimant manifests within 3 cycles of notification
NO_PUNISHMENT_FOR_NON_ACCEPTANCE = TRUE IF custodian withdraws before legal assumption
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning inheritance where no direct lineage exists, the Supreme Adhikari must identify the individual whose relational proximity aligns with dharmic expectation of care and continuity. Legal precedence is established not by will or title, but by manifest capacity for consciousness-aligned guardianship.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is based upon observable relational intimacy and demonstrated readiness to sustain dharma. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential manifestation of duty through spontaneous assumption. Responsibility is proportional to relational depth. No punitive consequence arises for refusal; only cessation of opportunity to serve dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Facilitate transfer until rightful assumptor emerges
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Encourage voluntary recognition of role
Capacity Restoration: Support reluctant parties in awakening innate dharmic awareness
Integrity Reintegration: Ensure continuity of estate reflects spiritual-economic harmony
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Sanatana Dharma's Juridical Truth. Property belongs not to blood nor name, but to conscious continuity. Justice restores order through awakened duty. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
